tasks.label: Mario: Random agent (Phase 1)
tasks.detail: Runs a random agent and saves data/random_agent.mp4 (container must be up).

tasks.label: Mario: Train PPO (Phase 2)
tasks.command: docker exec mario-jupyter bash -lc 'cd /app/src && python train_ppo.py --timesteps ${input:timesteps}'
tasks.detail: Trains a PPO agent (CPU, slow). Checkpoints -> data/models/, logs -> data/tb/.

tasks.label: Mario: Record trained agent (Phase 2)
tasks.command: docker exec mario-jupyter bash -lc 'cd /app/src && python record_agent.py'
tasks.detail: Plays one episode with the trained model and saves data/mario_ppo.mp4.

tasks.label: Mario: Train with curiosity (Phase 3)
tasks.command: docker exec mario-jupyter bash -lc 'cd /app/src && python train_curiosity.py --timesteps ${input:timesteps}'
tasks.detail: PPO + RND curiosity (game reward + intrinsic). Model -> data/models/mario_curiosity_*.zip.

tasks.label: Mario: Train PURE curiosity (Phase 3)
tasks.command: docker exec mario-jupyter bash -lc 'cd /app/src && python train_curiosity.py --timesteps ${input:timesteps} --extrinsic-coef 0'
tasks.detail: No game reward at all — Mario driven only by curiosity. Model -> data/models/mario_pure_curiosity_*.zip.
